verificationSummary: The Fastify adapter serves same-origin static assets and strict gateway.v1/gateway.v2 commands, queries and durable SSE without granting ordinary business permissions to health, bootstrap or break-glass routes.
Every business request passes strict runtime parsing, injected authentication, Owner/Agent scope policy and the application Gateway service before reaching a Control Plane or Read Model.
Mutations reject wrong Host, Origin, Fetch Metadata, CSRF, media type, idempotency header, oversized body, unsupported schema, spoofed identity and cross-owner scope before business execution.

SSE carries a durable cursor, event ID and scope, sends heartbeats, respects Node stream backpressure and rejects duplicate cursor or non-increasing Run sequence; a stale v1 cursor returns a bounded Thread/Run snapshot refresh.
